Tesla is expanding its vehicle software and autonomous vehicle offerings.

* Tesla has rolled out Full Self-Driving (FSD) v15 with real-time AI rendering, with a wide release planned for December alongside the 2026 Holiday Update [1].
* The company is inviting select customers to order its driverless Cybercab for personal use at a price of $29,990, though it requires a $299 per month Autonomy Subscription and is limited to supported areas in Texas and Florida [2].
